View this post on the web at https://www.astralcodexten.com/p/open-thread-454

This is the weekly visible open thread. Post about anything you want, ask random questions, whatever. ACX has an unofficial subreddit [ https://substack.com/redirect/48e46e54-1e3a-4a08-92db-96240a26b0c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], Discord [ https://substack.com/redirect/2f01a748-f947-4cce-937d-c598c616b926?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], and bulletin board [ https://substack.com/redirect/452c5a15-0534-4868-b052-58eb4c3b6f8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], and in-person meetups around the world [ https://substack.com/redirect/81173102-6f3e-4daf-991c-8b15b8551962?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ]. Most content is free, some is subscriber only; you can subscribe here [ https://substack.com/redirect/8355e25e-07e9-41bc-a8ce-8f5edb79a44b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ]. Also:
1: EA college meetups update: Brigham Young University has changed its time/date/place, please check the list [ https://substack.com/redirect/4c52d4b9-d966-4361-bbd4-dc6841bf11cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ] for more information.
2: Reader Nikita Sokolsky has completed his work getting some extra Fatima documents from Portugal and translating them into English. You can find them at https://fatima-1917.com/ [ https://substack.com/redirect/57d513b1-c5f5-4a0e-9801-b6ceed35c532?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ] . And thanks again to Ana for handling the parts that required Portuguese profiency.
3: Rob Ennals, who made this year’s book review contest site, has gathered the reviews from earlier years into epubs here [ https://substack.com/redirect/1019da12-16eb-4f21-a718-0861b122d80f?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ].
4: Physicians For AI Safety [ https://substack.com/redirect/dfb0effc-916e-4d1d-bc5f-3f89e75af2c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ] wishes to advertise that they exist, are interested in talking to any physicians interested in AI safety, and have an open letter that such people can sign.
5: Sorry I’ve written so little recently (and forgot Friday’s book review entry). I’m pretty busy and will try to make up for it after that changes.
